items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: I don't mind Sweet Emma playing Closer Walk three times a night because I like to hear her sing it every time.

ctx.x: What about tunes? What sort of tunes do they play there?

Very restricted tunes in a lot of cases. I mean, this I don't mind so much. I don't mind Sweet Emma playing Closer Walk three times a night because I like to hear her sing it every time. But they do play fairly restricted tunes. They play Bill Bailey every night without fail at least once, often twice. They have to play The Saints. Well, I mean, they do sort of in a way have to, and I can understand that because I've had to play The Saints myself when I didn't want to. The bands that play don't really disappoint…
Who are some of the musicians who've really impressed you there? The musicians that really impressed me are Jim, especially Jim.
